notes.title: Don't Give Up - Update V 0.2
notes.content:
As a way to celebrate the Lunar New Year and the Lunar Sale on Steam, everyone who plays Don't Give Up until February 21 will have the chance to find the rare 'Lunar Necklace', which is hidden somewhere in the woods. Don't miss this opportunity, or you will have to wait for the next Lunar New Year!

Besides, as we are listening to you there in the Community Hub, we have also included some of your suggestions for improvements and fixed some problems of the previous version:
[list]
[*] A new font for the dialogue boxes;
[*] Difficulty curve rebalancing, making it less previsible and more challenging.
[/list]

We want to give our players the best experience, so we will always be creating new themes and updating the game with improvements and new features.

Continue participating in our Community Hub and giving your suggestions for new themes and improvements for DON'T GIVE UP! Enjoy some more gameplay while we are baking more content for the full release of the game!

notes.title: Don't Give Up - Update V 0.1
notes.content:
Good news! Thanks to your support, in less than a week since Don't Give Up release, we are updating it with:
[list]
[*] New sprites;
[*] New enemies;
[*] 2 original songs written especially for Don't Give Up Gameplays.
[/list]

Besides, as we are listening to you there in the Community Hub, we have also included some of your suggestions for improvements and fixed some problems of the previous version:
[list]
[*] Bugs Fixes;
[*] Difficulty curve rebalancing, making it less previsible and more challenging.
[/list]
We want to wish you all a merry Christmas and thank you for the support and feedback in our community.

We want to give our players the best experience, so we will always be creating new themes and updating the game with improvements and new features.

Continue participating in our Community Hub and giving your suggestions for new themes and improvements for DON'T GIVE UP! Enjoy some more gameplay while we are baking more content for the full release of the game!
